notes.title: Monster Taming Direct 2025 + Demo Update 1.2.2
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141845/96bae00ffa0fa50923846396b881a132fc1e7a3d.png"][/img][/p][p]Version 1.2.2 of the Insectile Demo is here![/p][p][/p][p]This update implements new animations to match the ones shown off in [b]Monster Taming Direct 2025![/b] If you have not seen the direct, I highly recommend you watch it [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fe0pgU-LvDM"]here![/url] [i](Thank you so much to Gym Leader Ed for selecting Insectile to be a part of the event!)[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]Animations[/h3][list][*][p]Taming now triggers a new animation where a jar clunks down over the target Insectile.[/p][/*][*][p]Morphing now triggers a new animation where the target Insectile wraps itself in silk.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Glitches[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a glitch where a lily pad in the Muddy Poppy Patch would disappear.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any feedback on the demo![/p][p][/p][p]I hope you all enjoy![/p]

notes.title: Insectile Design Contest! 🎨🐛
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141845/d206613badce0425d8513133e06167b0d1e716e3.png"][/img][/p][p]🎨 I'm hosting the [b]Insectile Design Contest![/b][/p][p][/p][p]🐛 Design a cute, puzzle-shaped bug! (Note: The submission does [b]not[/b] have to be pixel art!)[/p][p][/p][p]🏆 One winner [b]gets their design in the game[/b] and a [b]free copy of Insectile[/b] on release![/p][p]📅 [b]Deadline:[/b] July 25th[/p][p]✅ Read the full rules before entering![/p][p]🔁 [b]Please spread the word[/b] for other artists![/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Please note:[/i] [/b]The contest is being run on all of my socials (links are at the bottom of the event page). You are more than welcome to post your submission on multiple platforms. If unable to post a submission for any reason, feel free to DM me or shoot me an email with your submission.[/p][p][/p][p]I've always loved entering contests like this, so I am so excited to finally host of my own! I can't wait to see all of the wonderful entries![/p][p][/p][p]Good luck![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141845/4fa8d1d80ebbb60959f339b66009e661ef1ddb22.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Maps and Menus!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141845/bf08fea0803750086c8c093d71f310e23a82791b.png"][/img][/p][p]Version 1.2.0 of the Insectile Demo is here![/p][p][/p][p]There is very little new content this time around. Instead, this update is mostly [b][i]quality of life changes [/i][/b]related to the user interface. I’ve also included the patch notes for the previous two versions, which seemed too minor to feature on their own.[/p][p][/p][h3]User Interface Changes[/h3][list][*][p][b][i]All sections of the inventory have been remodeled.[/i][/b][/p][/*][*][p]Insectile and item icons now cast a slight shadow behind them in all menus.[/p][/*][*][p]When opening the inventory, it will now jump to the last tab you were in.[/p][/*][*][p]The “Insectiles” section has been broken into pages.[/p][/*][*][p][b][i]The “Map” section has been added to the inventory.[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]Please note:[/i][/b] If you have previously played the demo, the map will start blank. Rooms will need to be traversed to reveal them on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]The “Bestiary” section has been broken into pages.[/p][/*][*][p]The “Bestiary” section now shows silhouettes of all missing entries.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3][list][*][p][i][b]The Fiery Form Caster now changes shape after each usage.[/b][/i][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Glitches[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an inconsistency in the Soothe tutorial. (1.1.1)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a glitch with the Tame Gauge in multi-phase encounters. (1.1.2)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Other[/h3][list][*][p]Changed the placement order of Insectiles in the Scare tutorial, for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the color of the silhouette when taming an Insectile slightly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a coloration error on the Crawling Olives.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the mixing in the track “Powerful Pincers” (boss battle music).[/p][/*][*][p]Compressed audio files.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any feedback on the demo and stay tuned for a [b][i]super special announcement[/i][/b] [b][i]coming tomorrow![/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p]I hope you all enjoy![/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: Variants, New Faces, and New Game Plus!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45141845/f1aa75927e9152be03f698d8b88145209f98770b.png"][/img][/p][p]Version 1.1.0 of the Insectile Demo is here![/p][p][/p][h3]Gameplay Additions[/h3][list][*][p][i][b]Added 2 new Insectiles.[/b][/i][/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Added a new room[/b][/i] off of the pumpkin patch.[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Added 3 Insectile variants[/b][/i] which are recolored versions of existing Insectiles with different encounter effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Every sparkly encounter now contains a variant.[/p][/*][*][p]Sparkly encounters now respawn, but will not continue to drop Soft Silk after the first encounter.[/p][/*][*][p]The previously named “Blossomed Raindrop” is now a variant of the Apex Raindrop.[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Added the “Smash” effect[/b][/i] which can clear shells, lemons, and rocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Jam Drops now use the Smash effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Great Walking Geode now uses the Smash effect.[/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Added a rematch with the Great Walking Geode[/i][/b] which can be triggered by the "?" mushroom within the boss room after completing the demo.[/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Added New Game Plus[/i][/b] which is a quick way to hop back into the demo with extra options, making many potential challenge runs now possible. [/p][p][b][i]Please note:[/i][/b][i] if you have previously completed the demo and cannot access New Game Plus, try opening up the completed save file and grabbing a save point radish.[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3]User Interface Changes:[/h3][list][*][p][i][b]Added 4 additional save files.[/b][/i][/p][/*][*][p]Added toggles for sound and music.[/p][/*][*][p]Reorganized some menus in the game to now use tabs with icons.[/p][/*][*][p]The “capture” button is now called the “tame” button.[/p][/*][*][p][i][b]Added the tame gauge[/b][/i], which shows the probability of successfully taming an Insectile. It appears alongside the “tame” button.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed the “melee” button.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the “panic” button, which places a few random mushrooms for the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage pop-ups now bounce a tiny bit.[/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Every enemy attack is now telegraphed[/i] [/b]by a black thought bubble beside the opposing Insectile's health bar.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Glitches[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a glitch where the Apex Raindrops would get stuck swimming on the overworld.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some other small glitches.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I have been super excited for this update! Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any feedback on the demo. [/p][p][/p][p]I hope you all enjoy![/p]

notes.title: Check out the unique demo for Insectile, a bug-catching creature collection game with puzzle-battles
notes.content:
Insectile is an upcoming game that blends together exploration, creature collection and puzzle battles into what looks like quite a unique and charming experience. It will have Native Linux support and a demo is now available.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/check-out-the-unique-demo-for-insectile-a-bug-catching-creature-collection-game-with-puzzle-battles/
